expectation: Membrane ring on discrete round cells (cytotoxic T cells, some dimmer NK/DC), a minority of cells, scattered singly in stroma and clustered in T-rich zones, mostly inside CD3+ cells, with no signal in other tissue.
observed: A: many discrete yellow cells, scattered in some cores and dense in T-rich cores, with none in others. B, C, D: sparse, sharp, cell-sized rings or blobs on a dark background with no haze. E: CD8a marks a subset of cells with ring-like membranes; the merge shows many white (CD8a+CD3+) cells and no signal on CD3-negative tissue.
why: CD8a marks a distinct subset of cells with membrane-like rings, enriched in T-rich cores and mostly inside CD3+ cells, with a clean background.
notes: Discrete membrane-ringed cells, sparse in B and C and dense in T-rich cores in A. In E most CD8a+ cells also carry CD3 (white in the merge) and the signal does not spread into CD3-negative tissue. Background is clean.
